provenance.method: Word sets were chosen to make a structural test possible, not to detect authorship. A finding needs a quality attribute AND an assertion verb AND an artifact subject AND the absence of any referent. No single list decides anything on its own.
provenance.calibration: Historical claim-only calibration: 32,483 repository words with zero findings, three probe claims caught, and one architecture document with zero findings. This does not calibrate the added residue, sentence-pattern or paragraph checks.
provenance.notDetection: This is not an AI-authorship detector and must never be described as one. Detectors that classify authorship misfire on non-native English writing at rates above 60% (Liang et al., 2023, n=91). A structural check for 'this assertion carries no referent' makes a different claim and carries no accusation.
provenance.shelfLife: Evidence cues and contextual guards are heuristics. Phrase and rhythm checks are advisory; vocabulary, conventions and useful constructions change. A clean result establishes only that the implemented checks found nothing.

adaptation.source: Owner model repository book-anti-slop-review, local revision 17ad3bb50d556712bd6812a9460b15df33b5b019
adaptation.concepts: Publication residue in original bytes, advisory sentence constructions and paragraph thresholds, and manual evidence review. Independently implemented in JavaScript; no book-specific paths or policy defaults.
adaptation.verification: Unit fixtures exercise individual identities, diagnostic locations, threshold boundaries, contextual exceptions and copied-skill execution. These do not establish corpus precision, recall or future permanence.

estimateCuesRejected.note: These fired on sentences that state a fact rather than a prediction: a cache TTL, a retry window, a rate of decay. A cue must imply that work will be finished, not merely mention a duration.

rules.message: A metaphor is standing in for a mechanism.
rules.next: Replace it with the thing itself.
rules.never: Do not swap one metaphor for another. The defect is the substitution, not the particular word.
rules.why: These words are not banned and they are not evidence of a machine author. Each has a real technical use, which is what the `unless` guard on each pattern protects. The defect is reaching for an image instead of naming the mechanism — the same failure the claim rule catches, one level up.

rules.message: A structural tic that carries no information.
rules.next: State the point directly and delete the scaffolding around it.
rules.never: Do not treat this as evidence of who wrote the text. It is a writing defect, not an authorship finding.
rules.why: Structural tics do not decay by model generation the way vocabulary does, which is why every pattern here is a shape rather than a word. Severity is info: these are the weakest signals in the file and they must never gate a build.

fires: But here's the thing: nobody reads the logs.

rules.message: A quality is asserted of an artifact with nothing a reader could check.
rules.next: Add the referent: a number, a measurement, a link, a file path, or the decision record that settled it. If there is no referent, delete the claim — the sentence was carrying no information.
rules.never: Do not soften the claim into a hedge. "Reasonably robust" is the same sentence with less courage, and it still says nothing.
rules.why: The defect in an AI-written architecture document is not vocabulary; it is confident assertion with no referent. No prose linter checks this: proselint has no such rule, and write-good's entire weasel-word check is a 26-word list.

fires: This approach is robust and scalable.
The new architecture ensures the system remains maintainable.

passes: This approach is robust: it survived the 12-hour soak test at 4k rps.
The migration is faster, measured at p99 120ms against 400ms before.
Prefer a modular layout when the module boundary is already obvious.
See ADR-0007 for why the system is loosely coupled here.
A robust parser is one that does not crash on malformed input.
Do not write "our design is modular" without saying what makes it so.
The sentence "this approach is robust" asserts nothing a reader can check.
The report must make no claim that the scaffold is validated or production-ready.
Reviewers do not claim the system is secure without a threat model.

rules.message: A duration is offered as a prediction.
rules.next: State what is done, what is left, and what blocks it. Those are facts a reader can act on.
rules.never: Do not replace the number with a vaguer one. "A short while" is the same prediction with the accountability removed.
rules.why: GOOD_ENGINEERING_H.md states this as an absolute: never report estimated time to complete a goal, feature, or objective. Nothing in the toolchain enforced it until now.
